note: Existing tracked capture reused as the stencil deferred baseline; no new .rdc was produced for this preflight.

children.name: Deferred Shading (Stencil)
children.note: One fullscreen triangle per light (2 draws = 2 lights in this scene).

children.name: Render Opaques Forward Only
children.note: Executes after deferred lighting and writes into the same lighting attachment.

deferredLightingDraw.note: Writes directly to the lighting attachment through fixed-function blending. A compute dispatch cannot do that, hence the RGBA16F UAV plus fullscreen resolve (D8).

forwardOnlyDraw.note: Kept in clustered mode (D16); the material type mask leaves these pixels at 0 so the compute does not double-light them.

implications: Stencil deferred cost scales with light count (one fullscreen draw per light); the clustered compute is one dispatch.
Forward-only opaque is a real path in this scene; D9 would have removed draw 776 and its object.
The lighting attachment is R11G11B10; the clustered resolve must keep the same blend semantics (One One, Zero One).
